notes: Tail case, all units rewritten. U1 mask is the customer's white hair-covered cape (ref said 'barber at the left', person-level colour) -> cape recolour. U2 mask was the barber's purple undershirt collar with a person->clothing replace and shared the barber with U4 -> retargeted to the fluorescent tube light at the top edge (SAM3 v2). U3 mask was only the top of a blurred, cut-off chair back at the far left edge whose lower parts overlap a second chair -> retargeted to the whole dark red barber chair in the background below the blue spray bottles (SAM3 v2). U4 bracelet kept on the barber (now the only barber unit), ref disambiguated from the other wrist's band, payload specific.

units.reason: Retarget: the old mask was only the upper back of a blurred chair cut off at the far left edge (not the centre), so a whole-chair removal did not match it. The background chair is fully visible and segmented by SAM3 p1_1.
